detail: Captured Intents revenue is used to buy back NEAR from this date

title: NEAR Lake stops indexing
detail: NEAR docs say the AWS S3 lake no longer indexes new blocks

title: Kai-Ching claim stream and a Sweat key migration stop
detail: First full day without hotwallet.kaiching's batch of about 2,000,000 accounts a day, which ended about 14:18 UTC on 2026-04-01; sweat-migration.near's last batch ended about 07:16 UTC on 2026-04-02. Together they explain 99% of the fall in txns and all of the fall in active_accounts_with_relayed. On-chain cause only: no statement from Cosmose or NEAR was found. See docs/USAGE_BREAK_2026-04-02.md

title: relay.tg stops relaying
detail: relay.tg, an unlabelled relayer that by its name served HOT's Telegram accounts, went from 118,799 transactions on 2026-04-12 to 57,247 on 04-13 and 930 on 04-14 (fct_contract_daily). Transactions without the batch streams stepped from about 952,000 a day (3 to 12 April) to 760,000 (15 to 30 April). A second step after the break of 2026-04-02. On-chain reading only: no statement from HOT was found

title: Kai-Ching deletes its dead accounts
detail: From 2026-10-02 to 10-08 hotwallet.kaiching sent 560,094 transactions and 561,960 accounts were deleted, matching day for day (fct_contract_daily, fct_chain_daily.deleted_accounts). An account signs its own deletion, so active_signers tripled on those days; distinct_signers leaves them out. That the deleted accounts were Kai-Ching's rests on that match

title: Callers of HOT's game step up
detail: game.hot.tg had 57,824 callers on 2026-11-02, 88,395 on 11-03 and 106,235 on 11-04, and distinct signers went from 47,976 to 79,100 over the same two days (fct_contract_daily, fct_chain_daily). The cause is not known: the warehouse holds the counts only

title: Sweat Wallet due to end in its present form
detail: Sweat's notices give this date for the end of Sweat Wallet in its present form. sweat-relayer.near carried a quarter of the transactions outside the batch streams in the 30 days to 2026-11-10 (fct_usage_quality_daily), so another break in the counts is likely

title: Developer gas rebate removed with protocol version 87
detail: Protocol version 87 took effect at 11:46:29 UTC with block 223012337, the first block of a new epoch, and set the contracts' share of gas from 30% to 0, so vote.dao proposal 27 has taken effect and gas burn is now the whole fee. The nightly config read of 2026-11-04 came before it and the read of 2026-11-05 after it. See registry/protocol_upgrades.csv, fct_protocol_config and fct_supply_daily

title: Protocol version 88 switches on the universal_accounts setting
detail: Protocol version 88 took effect at 12:17:42 UTC with block 223314737, the first block of a new epoch. Besides the version, three of the protocol config's values changed: universal_accounts went from false to true and the two universal_state_init_to_account_id costs rose. The contracts' share of gas stayed 0. The nightly config read of 2026-11-06 came before it and the read of 2026-11-07 after it. See registry/protocol_upgrades.csv and fct_protocol_config

title: NearBlocks stops computing circulating supply
detail: Its /v1/charts and /v1/stats figure has read 1,249,836,992 NEAR since this day. Its rewrite of 2025-09-03 removed the lockup job. See docs/CIRCULATING_SUPPLY.md

title: Genesis allocations finish unlocking
detail: Month 60 after transfers were enabled, as NEAR's 2020 post planned. On the chain, lockups made in 2020 hold almost nothing from then on; 7.6M NEAR stayed locked, all but a few NEAR in lockups made later

title: NearBlocks' circulating supply endpoint starts returning total supply
detail: CoinMetrics' estimated market cap follows on 2025-10-25, because its supply reaches it from this endpoint through CoinGecko

title: Issuance halved to 2.5% a year
detail: Protocol version 81 is first seen in the first block of 2025-10-29 (dim_block_day), and 2025-10-30 is the first full day at the new cap: the NEAR minted in a day fell from about 159K to about 84K (fct_supply_daily). This is the cut proposed in the forum thread of June 2025 taking effect

title: treasury.near pays out 9.8M NEAR
detail: treasury.near sent 4.9M NEAR to each of ecotreasury4.multisignature.near and ecotreasury5.multisignature.near. Before this day 7 NEAR had left it since 2020, and the day before it held 29.92M NEAR, its peak (fct_wallet_transfers, fct_wallet_balance_daily). Who controls the receivers is not recorded here

title: treasury.near pays out 20.4M NEAR
detail: treasury.near sent 20,371,200 NEAR in five transfers to the account dcc79d2cbd9dcfd6159793a987619b5d7b7446d594aba451318a84b6acb40058, which left it with 48 NEAR. With the payout of 2026-04-15 that makes 30.17M NEAR (fct_wallet_transfers). Who controls the receiver is not recorded here

title: NEAR HACKATHON announced
detail: NEAR announced the hackathon on X. Code written from this day counts toward an entry; the development phase runs from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-14 23:59 UTC. This warehouse and its site are an entry in the Investment Thesis track

title: NEAR HACKATHON development phase begins
detail: Submissions are accepted from 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC to 2026-11-14 23:59 UTC, and results are due by 2026-11-18

title: Most Intents volume moves to confidential settlement
detail: Public routes carried 60% to 68% of all-route volume on 24 to 28 October 2026, 33% to 48% from 29 October to 2 November, 18% on 3 November and under 9% on every day from 4 to 10 November, while all-route volume stayed between $73M and $192M a day (fct_intents_daily). NEAR's own dashboard shows the same fall in its volume by Intents type. Reading of the counts only: no announcement was found for this date

title: HSP-029's timelock is due to end
detail: vote.dao gives 2026-11-16 16:48 UTC as the end of proposal 29's timelock (fct_governance_proposals.timelock_end_utc). By the proposal's own text validators must still adopt the change, so this is not the day the ramp starts
